scope: One full-file reproduction after the complete real-PG lane, preserving test ordering after rollback controls. No assertions, timeouts, fixtures, dependencies, or application config changed. No retries.
commandDetails: submission-metadata.json contains full executable/argv, runtime, cwd, UTC start/end, exit code, and log path.

originalFailure.test: emits only stable identifier metadata when a submission transaction fails
originalFailure.classification: Empty captured log delta at first expected-metadata assertion. Not a test timeout. No sentinel leakage demonstrated because later absence assertions did not execute.

sourceEvidence.observation: flushCapturedLogs waits for logger.flush callback, sleeps a fixed 300ms, reads capturedLogDir/server.log, and returns empty string on any read exception.
Test snapshots before capture, installs jobs failure trigger, submits sentinel-bearing fixture input, asserts HTTP500, then slices the second capture by before.length.

First log assertion requires job_submission_internal_error; assertions for organization/company/source and absence of marker/source_intent/query/params/stack follow. Original failure stops at this first assertion.
Normal logger uses pino transport with pino-pretty stdout and file targets. File destination is fixed when module resolves its log directory.
Unexpected submission failure sets organizationId, companyId, sourceKind, replayed false, and fixed reasonCode on response before throwing to error middleware.

currentRunEvidence.observation: Target submission request produced HTTP500 job_submission_internal_error with stable organizationId/companyId/sourceKind/replayed/reasonCode plus sanitized HttpError type/message. All target assertions passed, including sentinel/query/params/stack exclusions.

unresolved: Original capture delta was empty. Exact cause has not been measured: async log delivery timing, capture sink binding, or a swallowed file-read error are hypotheses. Passing reproduction does not erase the original lane failure.
